posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out OpenAI News · 🟢 ChatGPT · 📣 Official · 49m ago • Albertsons uses ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI API to accelerate internal team workflows and improve customer grocery shopping experience. • Deployment aims to help millions of grocery shoppers while enabling faster operations across Albertsons' retail operations. • Integration focuses on practical retail application rather than announced flagship AI features or headline-grabbing capabilities. 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free? The Verge – AI · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • OpenAI announced Dots, an AI agent powered by GPT, at DevDay to compete with Meta's Muse platform. • Meta's free Muse AI agent has gained significant early traction, creating pricing pressure for OpenAI's offering. • OpenAI is competing directly with rivals on agent capabilities rather than cost alone. 🤖 AI Platform AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games The Decoder · 🔵 Gemini · 3h ago • Ataraxos AI defeated the best Stratego player ever, conquering a game where pieces start face-down. • Carnegie Mellon researchers outpaced Google Deepmind's 2023 failed multimillion-dollar attempt at the same challenge. • Stratego victory represents a rare remaining human stronghold in competitive board games falling to AI. 📰 Also covered by: Ars Technica – AI Read more →
